newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers firm peak, off-peak power on Fri.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers firm peak, off-peak power on Fri.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered firm power during on-peak as well as off-peak hours on Friday, the agency said Thursday.
For Thursday pre-scheduling, BPA had only offered up to 500 megawatts (MW) of power during peak hours, but augmented that by 200 MW of off-peak power for Friday.
BPA left off-peak prices unchanged at $25.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for both Northwest and California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries.
Firm on-peak power for Northwest deliveries was offered at $37.00 per MWh, while COB was offered at $38.00.
